newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index firms on gains to major shares.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index firms on gains to major shares.

text.p: The Bratislava Stock Exchange's SAX index firmed 0.22 points to 204.27 in moderate trading on Tuesday, boosted by gains to several leading issues.
Oil refinery Slovnaft closed up 10 crowns at its nominal value of 1,000 crowns, while steel maker VSZ gained five crowns to 720 to help lead the bourse higher.
Brokers said the current downtrend on neighbouring markets throughout the region should not affect the Slovak market since it has developed more slowly than most.

"I expect this development will not reflect much on our market as we are way in the backwoods," Dusan Sykora of ING Barings said adding that thin volumes on offer have been influencing also the entire market at the presence.

"We see relatively strong interest in the market, but there is almost nothing to offer from our side at the moment. However, if it comes to an overall decrease, I don't expect it to be for a long period," Sykora said.
Overall volume increased to 234,465 shares, from 149,690 shares traded on Monday, while turnover rose to 223.42 million crowns, from 97.50 million.
